name: Launcher Improved
summary: Add, arrange and hide apps in the stock tray
description: Add installed apps to the tray or to folders, including apps that were hidden or unlisted. Shorter menus group editing actions together. Quick Settings initializes when opened, not when the tray starts.
author: thooton

changes.text: Rebuild with the Windows-safe mod checks.
Use the Sonim Messaging and Music icons and restore AppDrawer artwork [skip ci].
Mods: stock-signed builds for Messages, Launcher and Music; remove OEM signing.
Splice dex into the stock APKs for test deploys.
Distinguish historical mod tests from current signed-device checks.
Verify renamed Messages hook targets in release builds.
Rename Launcher Improved and preserve installed settings.
Consolidate mod builds and require authorized release signatures.
